course.title: Water Resources Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A catchment of area 140 km²received 125cm rainfall in a year. At the (12) outlet of the catchment, the flow in the stream draining the catchment was found to have an average rate of 2.0m³/s for 3 months, 3.0m³/s for 5 months and 6.0m³/s for 4 months.
(i) What is the runoff co-efficient for the catchment?

(ii) If afforestation of the catchment reduced the runoff co-efficient to 0.55, what is the increase in the abstraction from precipitation due to infiltration from precipitation due to infiltration, evaporation and transpiration, for the same annual rainfall of 125cm?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
